examples.zh: 董事会在新一轮拨款前加强了项目组合治理。
examples.en: The board strengthened portfolio governance before the funding cycle.

examples.zh: 项目组合治理决定哪些项目获得稀缺的工程资源。
examples.en: Portfolio governance determines which projects receive scarce engineering resources.

examples.zh: 总监发布了未来四个季度的项目群路线图。
examples.en: The director published a program roadmap for the next four quarters.

examples.zh: 项目群路线图将系统升级与工厂里程碑关联。
examples.en: The program roadmap links system upgrades to factory milestones.

examples.zh: 更快的资格验证是这项提案的主要价值驱动因素。
examples.en: Faster qualification is the main value driver for this proposal.

examples.zh: 减少客户等待时间是另一个价值驱动因素。
examples.en: Lower customer waiting time is another value driver.

examples.zh: 项目进入执行阶段前先指定收益负责人。
examples.en: Name a benefit owner before the project enters execution.

examples.zh: 收益负责人检查承诺的人工节省是否兑现。
examples.en: The benefit owner checks whether promised labor savings materialize.

examples.zh: 试验后，自动化项目达到了投资门槛。
examples.en: The automation project cleared the investment hurdle after the trial.

examples.zh: 投资门槛要求具备可信的正现金流实现路径。
examples.en: The investment hurdle requires a credible path to positive cash flow.

examples.zh: 三个试点都必须控制在获批资金总额度内。
examples.en: All three pilots must stay within the approved funding envelope.

examples.zh: 资金总额度包含设备采购和安装支持。
examples.en: The funding envelope includes equipment purchases and installation support.

examples.zh: 财务每季度审查资本配置。
examples.en: Finance reviews capital allocation every quarter.

examples.zh: 资本配置转向更换不可靠的生产设备。
examples.en: Capital allocation shifted toward replacing unreliable production equipment.

examples.zh: 我们用优先级框架处理积压的改进事项。
examples.en: We applied a prioritization framework to the improvement backlog.

examples.zh: 优先级框架权衡安全、客户影响和工作量。
examples.en: The prioritization framework weighs safety, customer impact, and effort.

examples.zh: 发起人解决了两项上线之间的资源争用。
examples.en: The sponsors resolved resource contention between the two launches.

examples.zh: 两个项目争用同一试验箱，导致双方都延误。
examples.en: Resource contention delayed both projects using the same test chamber.

examples.zh: 我们调整了行动排序以保障工厂停机安排。
examples.en: We adjusted initiative sequencing to protect the plant shutdown.

examples.zh: 行动排序将数据清理安排在系统迁移之前。
examples.en: Initiative sequencing places data cleanup ahead of system migration.

examples.zh: 项目管理办公室维护着涵盖所有工作流的综合主计划。
examples.en: The PMO maintains an integrated master plan across all workstreams.

examples.zh: 综合主计划揭示了各部门共同的里程碑。
examples.en: The integrated master plan reveals shared milestones across departments.

examples.zh: 更改交货日期前先记录每项预测假设。
examples.en: Document each forecast assumption before changing the delivery date.

examples.zh: 我们的预测假设是供应商增加一个班次。
examples.en: Our forecast assumption is that the supplier adds another shift.

examples.zh: 缓冲余量帮助生产线吸收短期需求波动。
examples.en: The buffer helps the line absorb short-term demand volatility.

examples.zh: 需求波动使每月的人员配置决策更加困难。
examples.en: Demand volatility makes monthly staffing decisions more difficult.

examples.zh: 供应商更改交期后，重新检查计划参数。
examples.en: Review the planning parameters after the supplier changes its lead time.

examples.zh: 错误的计划参数导致采购订单量过大。
examples.en: An incorrect planning parameter caused unnecessarily large purchase orders.

examples.zh: 团队用需求感知调整每周生产计划。
examples.en: The team uses demand sensing to adjust the weekly build plan.

examples.zh: 需求感知利用近期销售来细化短期估计。
examples.en: Demand sensing uses recent sales to refine short-term estimates.

examples.zh: 我们针对产能决策开展了一次情景规划演练。
examples.en: We ran a scenario-planning exercise for the capacity decision.

examples.zh: 情景规划让我们为设备延迟和需求减弱作好准备。
examples.en: Scenario planning prepared us for delayed equipment and weaker demand.

examples.zh: 供应商在爬坡期间保留产能余量。
examples.en: The supplier maintains a capacity cushion during the ramp-up.

examples.zh: 产能余量承接了一笔意外的替换订单。
examples.en: The capacity cushion absorbed an unexpected replacement order.

examples.zh: 只有项目经理可以动用进度应急余量。
examples.en: Only the project manager can release the schedule contingency.

examples.zh: 进度应急余量用于应对法规审查可能的延误。
examples.en: The schedule contingency covers possible delays in regulatory review.

examples.zh: 职能经理核实了资源加载进度表。
examples.en: The functional managers validated the resource-loaded schedule.

examples.zh: 资源加载进度表为每项安装任务分配技术员。
examples.en: The resource-loaded schedule assigns technicians to each installation task.

examples.zh: 我们对不确定的资格验证阶段采用滚动式规划。
examples.en: We use rolling-wave planning for the uncertain qualification stages.

examples.zh: 滚动式规划使下周的工作保持详细且可执行。
examples.en: Rolling-wave planning keeps next week's work detailed and actionable.

examples.zh: 运营模式将每项决策权分配给一个角色。
examples.en: The operating model assigns each decision right to one role.

examples.zh: 供应商选择的决策权属于采购部门。
examples.en: The decision right for supplier selection belongs to procurement.

examples.zh: 承诺支出前先查阅审批权限矩阵。
examples.en: Consult the approval matrix before committing the spend.

examples.zh: 审批权限矩阵要求大额采购有两人签名。
examples.en: The approval matrix requires two signatures for large purchases.

examples.zh: 采购员按权限委派规定处理了紧急订单。
examples.en: The buyer followed the delegation of authority for the emergency order.

examples.zh: 权限委派让主管可以批准小额维修费用。
examples.en: The delegation of authority lets supervisors approve small repair expenses.

examples.zh: 组织变更后更新责任分配矩阵。
examples.en: Update the RACI matrix after the organization change.

examples.zh: 责任分配矩阵区分了批准人与日常操作人员。
examples.en: The RACI matrix distinguishes the approver from the daily operator.

examples.zh: 委员会满足法定出席要求后进行了表决。
examples.en: The committee met the quorum requirement before voting.

examples.zh: 两位成员缺席使我们无法满足法定出席要求。
examples.en: Two absent members prevented us from meeting the quorum requirement.

examples.zh: 票数相等后，主席行使了决定性投票权。
examples.en: The chair exercised a casting vote after the tie.

examples.zh: 主席的决定性一票解决了设备选择的平票局面。
examples.en: The chair's casting vote settled the tied equipment selection.

examples.zh: 合作方就紧急变更商定了决策程序。
examples.en: The partners agreed on a decision protocol for urgent changes.

examples.zh: 决策程序要求记录被否决的选项及理由。
examples.en: The decision protocol requires recording rejected options and reasons.

examples.zh: 申请豁免前先确定例外批准权人。
examples.en: Identify the exception authority before requesting a waiver.

examples.zh: 只有例外批准权人可以允许未经该测试的出货。
examples.en: Only the exception authority can permit shipment without that test.

examples.zh: 经理未超出她的授权限额。
examples.en: The manager stayed within her delegated limit.

examples.zh: 这笔采购超出我的授权限额五千美元。
examples.en: This purchase exceeds my delegated limit by five thousand dollars.

examples.zh: 审计确认了每个审批步骤的控制负责人。
examples.en: The audit confirmed the control owner for every approval step.

examples.zh: 控制负责人审查每周对账的证据。
examples.en: The control owner reviews evidence of weekly reconciliation.

examples.zh: 在评审前两天发送简明的会前阅读材料。
examples.en: Send a concise pre-read two days before the review.

examples.zh: 会前阅读材料包含拟议布局的示意图。
examples.en: The pre-read includes a diagram of the proposed layout.

examples.zh: 团队为发起人准备了一份决策简报。
examples.en: The team prepared a decision briefing for the sponsor.

examples.zh: 决策简报比较了租赁和购买机器。
examples.en: The decision briefing compares leasing with buying the machine.

examples.zh: 写一份明确说明所需决定的升级处理简报。
examples.en: Write an escalation brief that states the decision needed.

examples.zh: 升级处理简报请求帮助争取紧缺的实验室时段。
examples.en: The escalation brief requests help securing scarce laboratory time.

examples.zh: 传播团队为供应商公告制作了信息地图。
examples.en: Communications built a message map for the supplier announcement.

examples.zh: 信息地图让经理能一致地回答员工问题。
examples.en: The message map gives managers consistent answers to staff questions.

examples.zh: 根据紧急程度和受众选择适当的沟通渠道。
examples.en: Choose the right communication channel for the urgency and audience.

examples.zh: 电子邮件是合同变更的正式沟通渠道。
examples.en: Email is the formal communication channel for contract changes.

examples.zh: 发送更新前先定义各利益相关方的信息需求。
examples.en: Define each stakeholder's information need before sending updates.

examples.zh: 仓库经理的信息需求包含每日到货量。
examples.en: The warehouse manager's information need includes daily inbound volume.

examples.zh: 法务在发布前满足了征询要求。
examples.en: Legal satisfied the consultation requirement before release.

examples.zh: 征询要求包含征求安全工程师的意见。
examples.en: The consultation requirement includes input from the safety engineer.

examples.zh: 引导员针对该假设进行了深入追问。
examples.en: The facilitator asked a probing question about the assumption.

examples.zh: 一个深入追问揭示了估计的计算方法。
examples.en: A probing question uncovered how the estimate was calculated.

examples.zh: 主席在投票前作了总结性陈述。
examples.en: The chair made a summarizing statement before the vote.

examples.zh: 她的总结性陈述概括了共识与尚存的担忧。
examples.en: Her summarizing statement captured both agreement and remaining concerns.

examples.zh: 清晰的会前阅读材料提高了会议成效。
examples.en: A clear pre-read improved meeting effectiveness.

examples.zh: 每项行动都有负责人后，会议成效提高了。
examples.en: Meeting effectiveness improved when every action had an owner.

examples.zh: 选择对策前先梳理因果路径。
examples.en: Map the causal pathway before selecting a countermeasure.

examples.zh: 因果路径将受潮与密封失效联系起来。
examples.en: The causal pathway connects moisture exposure to seal failure.

examples.zh: 再做一次试验就能填补主要证据缺口。
examples.en: One additional trial will close the main evidence gap.

examples.zh: 证据缺口涉及冷藏期间的性能。
examples.en: The evidence gap concerns performance during cold storage.

examples.zh: 对提出的原因进行反事实检验。
examples.en: Apply a counterfactual test to the proposed cause.

examples.zh: 反事实检验询问没有振动时是否仍发生失效。
examples.en: A counterfactual test asks whether failure occurs without vibration.

examples.zh: 继续采集数据前先提出可证伪主张。
examples.en: State a falsifiable claim before collecting more data.

examples.zh: 可证伪主张预测更换密封件后泄漏会减少。
examples.en: A falsifiable claim predicts fewer leaks after the seal change.

examples.zh: 工程师针对温度变化提出了一个诊断问题。
examples.en: The engineer posed a diagnostic question about the temperature shift.

examples.zh: 这个诊断问题区分电气故障和机械阻塞。
examples.en: The diagnostic question distinguishes electrical failure from mechanical blockage.

examples.zh: 评审比较了三个竞争假设。
examples.en: The review compared three competing hypotheses.

examples.zh: 一个竞争假设将噪声归因于安装螺栓松动。
examples.en: A competing hypothesis attributes the noise to loose mounting bolts.

examples.zh: 批准根因结论前先寻找反证。
examples.en: Seek disconfirming evidence before approving the root cause.

examples.zh: 完好的样品提供了反驳运输致损假设的证据。
examples.en: The undamaged samples provided disconfirming evidence against the transport theory.

examples.zh: 我们利用日志、样品和访谈进行了数据交叉验证。
examples.en: We used data triangulation across logs, samples, and interviews.

examples.zh: 交叉验证结合了维护记录、访谈与直接观察。
examples.en: Triangulation combined maintenance records with interviews and direct observation.

examples.zh: 基准发生率比较显示这种失效并不常见。
examples.en: A base-rate comparison showed that the failure was unusual.

examples.zh: 基准发生率比较有助于客观看待一个令人担忧的结果。
examples.en: A base-rate comparison puts one alarming result in perspective.

examples.zh: 对采购量假设进行敏感性检查。
examples.en: Run a sensitivity check on the volume assumption.

examples.zh: 敏感性检查采用了几种合理的汇率。
examples.en: The sensitivity check uses several plausible exchange rates.

examples.zh: 评审将执行风险与设计风险分开评估。
examples.en: The review assessed execution risk separately from design risk.

examples.zh: 主管时间有限，增加了推广期间的执行风险。
examples.en: Limited supervisor time increases execution risk during the rollout.

examples.zh: 在上线计划中追踪每项实施依赖。
examples.en: Track every implementation dependency in the launch plan.

examples.zh: 扫描器安装是电子收货的实施依赖条件。
examples.en: Scanner installation is an implementation dependency for electronic receiving.

examples.zh: 厂区必须满足每项就绪标准后才能切换。
examples.en: The site must meet every readiness criterion before cutover.

examples.zh: 一项就绪标准要求每班都有受训的后备操作员。
examples.en: One readiness criterion requires trained backup operators on every shift.

examples.zh: 在最终评审中核实每项启动条件。
examples.en: Verify each launch condition during the final review.

examples.zh: 成功备份数据是一项启动条件。
examples.en: A successful data backup is a launch condition.

examples.zh: 运营部门批准了三家工厂的部署顺序。
examples.en: Operations approved the deployment sequence for three plants.

examples.zh: 部署顺序从最小的区域仓库开始。
examples.en: The deployment sequence starts with the smallest regional warehouse.

examples.zh: 团队在周末变更前演练了切换计划。
examples.en: The team rehearsed the cutover plan before the weekend change.

examples.zh: 切换计划预留了核查库存余额的时间。
examples.en: The cutover plan reserves time for checking inventory balances.

examples.zh: 为交易失败定义一个回退触发条件。
examples.en: Define a rollback trigger for transaction failures.

examples.zh: 反复登录失败在几分钟内达到了回退触发条件。
examples.en: Repeated login failures met the rollback trigger within minutes.

examples.zh: 该流程完成了两周的稳定期。
examples.en: The process completed a two-week stabilization period.

examples.zh: 稳定期内，主管每天早上审查错误。
examples.en: During the stabilization period, supervisors reviewed errors each morning.

examples.zh: 供应商将在上线后提供强化支持。
examples.en: The vendor will provide hypercare support after launch.

examples.zh: 上线强化支持包含为班组主管设置的专线。
examples.en: Hypercare support includes a dedicated hotline for shift supervisors.

examples.zh: 项目在交接测试后通过了运维验收。
examples.en: The project obtained operational acceptance after the handover test.

examples.zh: 运维验收要求提供备份恢复有效的证据。
examples.en: Operational acceptance requires evidence that backup restoration works.

examples.zh: 分拣库存前先界定遏制范围。
examples.en: Define the containment scope before sorting stock.

examples.zh: 遏制范围涵盖周一以来生产的每个批次。
examples.en: The containment scope covers every lot made since Monday.

examples.zh: 相机升级填补了最终检验中的一个探测缺口。
examples.en: The camera upgrade closed a detection gap at final inspection.

examples.zh: 探测缺口使内部裂纹未被发现。
examples.en: The detection gap allowed internal cracks to go unnoticed.

examples.zh: 审计通过预置错误测试了探测控制。
examples.en: The audit tested the detection control with a seeded error.

examples.zh: 重量检查是针对缺件的探测控制。
examples.en: A weight check is a detection control for missing components.

examples.zh: 防错定位夹具是一种更强的预防控制。
examples.en: A keyed fixture is a stronger prevention control.

examples.zh: 装入错误零件时，预防控制会阻止装配。
examples.en: The prevention control blocks assembly when the wrong part is loaded.

examples.zh: 独立抽样向客户提供了控制可靠性保证。
examples.en: Independent sampling provided control assurance to the customer.

examples.zh: 控制可靠性保证取决于证明检查确实执行的证据。
examples.en: Control assurance depends on evidence that checks actually occur.

examples.zh: 审阅人在关闭发现项前评估了证据充分性。
examples.en: The reviewer assessed evidence sufficiency before closing the finding.

examples.zh: 由于缺少夜班记录，证据充分性仍不确定。
examples.en: Evidence sufficiency remains uncertain because night-shift records are missing.

examples.zh: 审计员设计了覆盖所有班次的审计样本。
examples.en: The auditor designed an audit sample across all shifts.

examples.zh: 审计抽样包含每月月初与月末的交易。
examples.en: Audit sampling included transactions from the beginning and end of each month.

examples.zh: 公司在五家工厂实施了系统性纠正措施。
examples.en: The company implemented systemic corrective action across five plants.

examples.zh: 系统性纠正措施替换了组织内相互冲突的程序。
examples.en: Systemic corrective action replaced conflicting procedures across the organization.

examples.zh: 为每个确认的原因指定一位纠正措施负责人。
examples.en: Appoint one corrective-action owner for each confirmed cause.

examples.zh: 纠正措施负责人每周提交进展证据。
examples.en: The corrective-action owner submits weekly evidence of progress.

examples.zh: 质量部门立即冻结了可疑物料。
examples.en: Quality placed the suspect material on hold immediately.

examples.zh: 质量冻结防止仓库发运这些纸箱。
examples.en: The quality hold prevents the warehouse from shipping these cartons.

examples.zh: 销售收到客户预测后更新了需求预测。
examples.en: Sales updated the demand projection after the customer forecast.

examples.zh: 需求预测将重复订单与不确定的新业务分开。
examples.en: The demand projection separates repeat orders from uncertain new business.

examples.zh: 我们修订了进口零件的安全库存政策。
examples.en: We revised the safety stock policy for imported components.

examples.zh: 安全库存政策要求每季度复核交期。
examples.en: The safety stock policy requires quarterly lead-time reviews.

examples.zh: 库存达到临界水平前先设定补货触发条件。
examples.en: Set a replenishment trigger before stock reaches the critical level.

examples.zh: 补货触发条件采用供应商交期内的预期需求。
examples.en: The replenishment trigger uses expected demand during supplier lead time.

examples.zh: 循环盘点提高了仓库的库存准确率。
examples.en: Cycle counting improved inventory accuracy in the warehouse.

examples.zh: 操作员跳过领料扫描后，库存准确率下降了。
examples.en: Inventory accuracy fell when operators skipped material issue scans.

examples.zh: 计划员对海外零件的交期波动性进行了建模。
examples.en: The planner modeled lead-time variability for overseas parts.

examples.zh: 供应商更换承运人后，交期波动性增加了。
examples.en: Lead-time variability increased after the supplier changed carriers.

examples.zh: 短缺期间采用获批的优先分配规则。
examples.en: Apply the approved prioritization rule during the shortage.

examples.zh: 优先分配规则让紧急维修优先使用有限库存。
examples.en: The prioritization rule gives emergency repairs access to limited stock.

examples.zh: 销售总监批准了短缺分配方案。
examples.en: The sales director approved the shortage allocation.

examples.zh: 短缺分配为重要的医院订单保留了足够零件。
examples.en: Shortage allocation reserved enough components for critical hospital orders.

examples.zh: 更改树脂牌号前取得替代批准。
examples.en: Obtain substitution approval before changing the resin grade.

examples.zh: 替代批准要求阻燃和强度等级相符。
examples.en: Substitution approval requires matching fire-resistance and strength ratings.

examples.zh: 我们在旺季前完成了替代来源资格验证。
examples.en: We completed alternate source qualification before peak season.

examples.zh: 替代来源资格验证包括在第二家工厂试生产。
examples.en: Alternate source qualification includes production trials at the second factory.

examples.zh: 停产后，采购员启动了供应连续性计划。
examples.en: The buyer activated the supply continuity plan after the outage.

examples.zh: 供应连续性计划明确了备用仓库和承运人。
examples.en: The supply continuity plan identifies backup warehouses and carriers.

examples.zh: 财务在谈判前冻结了降本基线。
examples.en: Finance froze the cost reduction baseline before negotiations.

examples.zh: 降本基线不包含临时促销折扣。
examples.en: The cost reduction baseline excludes temporary promotional discounts.

examples.zh: 选择较便宜的机器前先估算全生命周期成本。
examples.en: Estimate lifecycle cost before choosing the cheaper machine.

examples.zh: 全生命周期成本包括处置费用和日常维护费用。
examples.en: Lifecycle cost includes disposal as well as routine maintenance.

examples.zh: 建立一个年采购量较低的敏感性情景模型。
examples.en: Model a sensitivity case with lower annual volume.

examples.zh: 该敏感性情景假定电价上涨百分之十。
examples.en: The sensitivity case assumes electricity prices rise by ten percent.

examples.zh: 展示有利与不利结果区间，而非单个精确数字。
examples.en: Present an upside-downside range instead of one exact number.

examples.zh: 有利与不利结果区间反映了上线时间的不确定性。
examples.en: The upside-downside range reflects uncertainty in launch timing.

examples.zh: 评估预付款的现金流影响。
examples.en: Assess the cash-flow impact of the advance payment.

examples.zh: 设备安装当月的现金流影响最大。
examples.en: The cash-flow impact is greatest during the equipment installation month.

examples.zh: 减少过剩库存释放了营运资金。
examples.en: Reducing excess inventory released working capital.

examples.zh: 更长的客户付款期会占用更多营运资金。
examples.en: Longer customer payment terms tie up more working capital.

examples.zh: 较小批量降低了库存持有成本。
examples.en: Smaller batches reduced inventory carrying cost.

examples.zh: 库存持有成本包括仓库租金和保险费。
examples.en: Inventory carrying cost includes warehouse rent and insurance premiums.

examples.zh: 指数上涨后，供应商援引了成本调价条款。
examples.en: The supplier invoked the cost escalation clause after the index rose.

examples.zh: 成本调价条款指明了用于调整的指数。
examples.en: The cost escalation clause names the index used for adjustments.

examples.zh: 双方商定了透明的价格调整机制。
examples.en: Both parties agreed on a transparent price adjustment mechanism.

examples.zh: 价格调整机制允许价格上调和下调。
examples.en: The price adjustment mechanism works in both directions.

examples.zh: 采购员在报价评审前建立了应有成本模型。
examples.en: The buyer built a should-cost model before the quotation review.

examples.zh: 应有成本模型估算了加工时间和材料损耗。
examples.en: The should-cost model estimates machining time and material waste.

examples.zh: 转型团队定义了未来的运营模式。
examples.en: The transformation team defined the future operating model.

examples.zh: 运营模式集中采购，同时保留本地排程。
examples.en: The operating model centralizes purchasing but keeps scheduling local.

examples.zh: 标准模板缩短了审批周期。
examples.en: A standard template shortened approval lead time.

examples.zh: 两位审阅人休假后，审批周期延长了。
examples.en: Approval lead time increased when two reviewers went on leave.

examples.zh: 研讨会提高了跨职能的职责清晰度。
examples.en: The workshop improved responsibility clarity across functions.

examples.zh: 职责清晰度帮助员工将投诉转交给正确团队。
examples.en: Responsibility clarity helped staff route complaints to the right team.

examples.zh: 计划揭示了一项对财务部门的组织依赖。
examples.en: The plan surfaced an organizational dependency on finance.

examples.zh: 该组织依赖涉及由IT批准新用户账号。
examples.en: The organizational dependency involves IT approving new user accounts.

examples.zh: 共享指标减少了跨部门摩擦。
examples.en: A shared metric reduced cross-functional friction.

examples.zh: 谁应调查交付错误的问题引发了跨部门摩擦。
examples.en: Cross-functional friction arose over who should investigate delivery errors.

examples.zh: 领导者在增加新行动前会监测变革饱和情况。
examples.en: Leaders monitor change saturation before adding another initiative.

examples.zh: 变革饱和使主管难以应对又一次软件推广。
examples.en: Change saturation made another software rollout difficult for supervisors.

examples.zh: 培训结束后追踪一项采用指标。
examples.en: Track an adoption metric after the training ends.

examples.zh: 我们的采用指标统计无需旧表格处理的订单。
examples.en: Our adoption metric counts orders processed without the old spreadsheet.

examples.zh: 主管在过渡期间进行了行为强化。
examples.en: Supervisors provided behavioral reinforcement during the transition.

examples.zh: 行为强化包括对正确完成检查及时给予反馈。
examples.en: Behavioral reinforcement included prompt feedback on correctly completed checks.

examples.zh: 重组为上线保留了管理能力余量。
examples.en: The reorganization protected managerial capacity for the launch.

examples.zh: 年度绩效评审期间，管理能力余量有限。
examples.en: Managerial capacity is limited during annual performance reviews.

examples.zh: 仪表板为领导层处理异常保留了注意力带宽。
examples.en: The dashboard preserved leadership attention bandwidth for exceptions.

examples.zh: 过多的状态会议消耗了团队的注意力带宽。
examples.en: Too many status meetings consume the team's attention bandwidth.

examples.zh: 团队在上线决策前夕审查了证据。
examples.en: The team reviewed the evidence on the eve of the launch decision.

examples.zh: 我们在安装前夕发现了接线故障。
examples.en: We discovered a wiring fault on the eve of installation.

examples.zh: 付款延迟使部分供应商财务紧张。
examples.en: Some suppliers are financially stressed by the payment delay.

examples.zh: 财务紧张的客户可能要求更长的付款期。
examples.en: Financially stressed customers may ask for longer payment terms.

examples.zh: 服务水平骤降至约定门槛以下。
examples.en: The service level plunged below the agreed threshold.

examples.zh: 订单可能骤降至我们的最低生产量以下。
examples.en: Orders could plunge below our minimum production volume.

examples.zh: 延误显而易见的解释是物料短缺。
examples.en: The obvious explanation for the delay is the material shortage.

examples.zh: 那个显而易见的解释与温度记录不符。
examples.en: The obvious explanation did not match the temperature records.

examples.zh: 文章讨论了当前的高通胀爆发。
examples.en: The article discusses the current outbreak of high inflation.

examples.zh: 模型探讨高通胀爆发如何影响工资。
examples.en: The model explores how an outbreak of high inflation affects wages.

examples.zh: 作者将这场冲突称为主动选择的战争。
examples.en: The author describes the conflict as a war of choice.

examples.zh: 这篇文章区分了主动选择的战争与自卫。
examples.en: The essay distinguishes a war of choice from self-defense.

examples.zh: 该海峡是重要的能源运输节点。
examples.en: The strait is an important energy transit point.

examples.zh: 关闭能源运输节点可能扰乱区域燃料供应。
examples.en: Closing an energy transit point could disrupt regional fuel supplies.

examples.zh: 报告警告保障覆盖率可能出现灾难性下降。
examples.en: The report warns of a catastrophic decline in coverage.

examples.zh: 订单灾难性下降会威胁工厂生存。
examples.en: A catastrophic decline in orders would threaten the factory's survival.

examples.zh: 数百万人可能失去医疗保险保障。
examples.en: Millions could lose health insurance coverage.

examples.zh: 她在预约手术前查看了医疗保险保障范围。
examples.en: She checked her health insurance coverage before booking surgery.

examples.zh: 小企业今年面临快速上涨的保费。
examples.en: Small firms face sharply rising premiums this year.

examples.zh: 快速上涨的保费迫使这家人比较更便宜的保险计划。
examples.en: Sharply rising premiums forced the family to compare cheaper plans.

examples.zh: 一些家庭设法勉强保住了保险保障。
examples.en: Some families managed to hang on to coverage.

examples.zh: 他们削减其他开支以勉强保住保险保障。
examples.en: They reduced other expenses to hang on to coverage.

examples.zh: 立法者就是否延续扩大的补贴展开辩论。
examples.en: Lawmakers debated whether to renew expanded subsidies.

examples.zh: 该提案将把扩大的补贴再延续一年。
examples.en: The proposal would renew expanded subsidies for another year.

examples.zh: 补贴帮助人们负担得起医疗保险。
examples.en: The subsidies helped make health insurance affordable.

examples.zh: 每月补贴可以让这户家庭负担得起保险。
examples.en: A monthly subsidy could make insurance affordable for this household.

examples.zh: 法案对申请人施加了惩罚性工作要求。
examples.en: The bill imposed punitive work requirements on applicants.

examples.zh: 批评者反对向受助者施加惩罚性工作要求的计划。
examples.en: Critics oppose plans to impose punitive work requirements on recipients.

examples.zh: 市场尚未感受到该政策的全部影响。
examples.en: The market has not yet felt the full effect of the policy.

examples.zh: 小供应商可能在下季度感受到全部影响。
examples.en: Small suppliers may feel the full effect next quarter.

examples.zh: 该提案将把改革的大部分影响推迟到后期。
examples.en: The proposal would backload the effects of the reform.

examples.zh: 该时间表将把主要影响推迟到过渡之后。
examples.en: The timetable would backload the effects until after the transition.

examples.zh: 对脆弱家庭而言，后果已经非常严重。
examples.en: The consequences have already been dire for vulnerable families.

examples.zh: 对没有积蓄的家庭而言，后果已经非常严重。
examples.en: The consequences have been dire for families without savings.

V20261022-118.gloss: 个人保险计划参保情况

examples.zh: 该机构追踪个人保险计划的参保情况。
examples.en: The agency tracks enrollment in individual plans.

examples.zh: 保费上涨后，个人保险计划参保人数下降了。
examples.en: Enrollment in individual plans fell after the premium increase.

examples.zh: 分析员在估算损失前汇总了数字。
examples.en: Analysts put the numbers together before estimating the loss.

examples.zh: 汇总两份仓库报告中的数字。
examples.en: Put the numbers together from both warehouse reports.

examples.zh: 最大的一轮成本上涨尚未显现。
examples.en: The largest cost increases have yet to kick in.

examples.zh: 新的运输费用尚未生效。
examples.en: The new shipping fees have yet to kick in.

examples.zh: 健康不佳可能降低终身收入潜力。
examples.en: Poor health can reduce lifetime earnings potential.

examples.zh: 额外的技术培训可能提高她的收入潜力。
examples.en: Additional technical training could improve her earnings potential.

examples.zh: 公司正处于重大变革之中。
examples.en: The company is in the midst of a major change.

examples.zh: 我们正在更换订单系统。
examples.en: We are in the midst of replacing our order system.

examples.zh: 这个问题得到的媒体报道出奇地少。
examples.en: The issue received surprisingly little media coverage.

examples.zh: 地方服务削减往往很少获得媒体报道。
examples.en: Local service cuts often receive little media coverage.

examples.zh: 交付可靠性的重要性仅次于质量。
examples.en: Delivery reliability ranks second only to quality.

examples.zh: 对这位客户而言，维修速度的重要性仅次于安全。
examples.en: For this customer, repair speed ranks second only to safety.

examples.zh: 作者认为这些削减是为了给减税腾出空间。
examples.en: The author argues that the cuts were used to make room for tax cuts.

examples.zh: 该预算提案将为减税腾出空间。
examples.en: The budget proposal would make room for tax cuts.
